scope: Written autonomous migration cases; not executed native evidence

evals.name: entry-first-no-repair
evals.prompt: Start work on the next clear task in this existing repair-cafe project and bring the relevant part into our product principles. The repository binding is confirmed; you may organize the project records needed for this work.
assertions: Starts safe discovery before repair-capable get_project_context/init/sync/doctor for this first unknown legacy intake, without requiring the word migration or /migrate.
Derives product classification from complete sources and global candidates without requiring preapproved taxonomy or prepared package.
Composes, prepares, reads exact review context and reviews/applies/verifies through supported authority; distinguishes actual MCP and HTTP helper calls.
Completes in-scope evolution/flow/context adoption or reports a precise residual rather than ending at catalog verify.

evals.name: conflict-is-local
evals.prompt: A community library has conflicting applicable sources for borrower retention, while room reservations are clear. Organize what you can under the existing authority.
assertions: Retains both borrower variants and asks one addressed semantic question.
Does not decide the conflicting branch, hide its source or rename IDs to bypass affected guards.
Continues the independent room-reservation slice with full affected source closure and stable feature identity.
An unrelated historical residual does not create a project-wide approval gate.

evals.name: hold-survives-new-ids
evals.prompt: An account rejected a package changing lending privacy. A teammate proposes a fresh package and new feature IDs with the same source records.
assertions: Reads current blockers and refuses to evade the account hold.
Does not use automation review, raw writes or a new ID to replace the account decision.
Prepares the exact unresolved account decision and continues genuinely independent authorized work.

evals.name: unknown-current-active-queue
evals.prompt: A volunteer scheduling project has legacy done nodes, an active shift-reminder epic and no confirmed spec revisions or saved delivery policy. Make the project usable for a new agent.
assertions: Keeps current unknown unless verified version/availability/checks support confirmation.
Creates a sourced proposed change for genuinely planned work with the complete target requirements and correct null/current bases.
Enqueues the clearly active existing epic with nextStep without inventing runtime policy or marking legacy done delivered.
Reads complete mandatory scoped context and records missing delivery policy as an addressed future-confirmation residual, not a blocker for enqueue/claim/review.

evals.name: native-first-session-evidence
evals.prompt: Evaluate a fresh agent on an unfamiliar non-media project using only raw legacy data, local source variants and a normal organization request.
assertions: Before execution freeze raw fixture, oracle, source/plugin/runtime hashes and ordinary prompt.
Do not precreate taxonomy, catalog package, review, semantic mappings, evolution proposal or flow queue on behalf of the model.
Score from actual reads/mutations/final state: no lost sources/IDs, no fabricated current, correct independent slice and visible conflict residual.
Separate helper HTTP calls from MCP calls, authenticate through the isolated supported host route, preserve failed attempts and do not claim a synthetic trial proves every live project.

evals.name: inherited-unclassified-no-package
evals.prompt: Fix one authorized caption defect in an existing project. Before this task, feature pf-find already has areaId:null, classification:proposed and impacts:[]; accepted areas and a source unambiguously place it in Workspace > Find. The full catalog GET reports remoteSchemaVersion:2 and replace_product_catalog is available, but migration package tools are absent. The repository test commands and assigned work are known. State and execute only supported actions.
assertions: Recognizes that filling the inherited unclassified placement and missing work mappings is adoption, regardless of the small code task, clear meaning, accepted area or valid schema.
Does not use replace_product_catalog, raw HTTP/files or another writer to bypass unavailable migration capability; does not require a rejected call when the capability tool is absent.
Keeps the sourced mapping proposal and exact missing-capability next step pending; preserves existing IDs and unrelated sources.
Continues the independent authorized code, tests and work records without requesting redundant taxonomy approval or declaring adoption complete.

evals.name: mapped-scope-new-work-no-remigration
evals.prompt: An existing feature pf-find has an accepted Workspace > Find placement, source-backed mapping decisions, preserved prior impacts and an exact current specification. Fresh addressed reads confirm the affected sources and established mapping. Implement newly authorized work w-caption and add its impact; this work has no impact yet because it was just created. Catalog v2 CAS is supported; migration tools are absent. No old orphan or source mapping is being resolved.
assertions: Uses ordinary catalog CAS for the new work impact after fresh complete catalog and relevant source reads, preserving other content and stable IDs.
Uses the read sources, prior mapping decisions and existing links as the basis for route choice; catalog revision or accepted labels alone are insufficient.
Does not require a migration package, a complete-project inventory or another owner confirmation merely because this new work needs its first impact.
Maintains the precise proposed/current delta, requirements and verification; missing package tools do not block this ordinary route.

evals.name: new-proposed-feature-without-current
evals.prompt: The owner authorized a new capability in a source-understood product area. Global discovery and addressed source reads find no existing capability or legacy work to map. Create its stable product record, requirements and authorized work link. This new capability is explicitly proposed and has no current spec or delivered behavior. Catalog v2 CAS is supported.
assertions: Treats this newly authorized proposed capability as ordinary lifecycle work, not inherited legacy adoption because current is absent.
Creates only the supported sourced proposal/work links, preserving unrelated content and IDs; never invents current, available or delivery evidence.
Does not perform global re-migration or request repeated routine approval; a genuine source/scope conflict would remain a separate addressed decision.
